name: Exact account slip retains contracts and values bonus separately
covers: GET /api/v1/underdog full-board player search and snapshot paging
description: Checks account-entered contracts, bonus-aware requirements and searchable public quotes without claiming a verified bet.
steps: Open Check my slip. In Selection 1 enter Alperen Sengun, event Rockets vs Spurs, Assists, threshold 5.5, Higher and Full game. In Selection 2 enter Austin Reaves, event Clippers vs Lakers, Assists, threshold 5.5, Lower and Full game. Confirm both account selection checkboxes.
Enter unboosted combined return 2.87 and displayed boosted return 3.33; leave 25 percent Profit boost, Bonus funds, bonus value 0 and maximum payout checked. Click Check exact entry.

Verify HOLD and recommended stake $0. Cash return per $1 is $2.870 and bonus return is $0.460. Break-even is 34.84 percent and +3 percent EV requirement is 35.89 percent. Both entered Assists 5.5 selections remain unchanged, regardless of public quote availability; unknown models and maximum payout are blockers.

Change bonus value assumption to 1. The previous checked result disappears. Check again: break-even is 30.03 percent and +3 percent requirement is 30.93 percent. Neither value is described as a predicted hit rate.

Change Selection 1 to Points + Rebounds at 19.5 and check again; result must preserve that market rather than Points + Rebounds + Assists. Refresh, reopen Check my slip and confirm draft fields persist while account confirmations must be checked again.

Search public props for an NBA player using Search player and Search public props. Expect matching full-name markets, an empty state or visible source error, never qualified bets. Clear player filter and search. If Next page is available, inspect the next range or a visible snapshot-changed error requiring a new search. Public availability, price timestamp and unknown periods remain unverified.
Click My Wagers in the top navigation.
Confirm the tracker includes manual actual and paper wager tabs, not a place-bet function.
Inspect any previously tracked records if available; avoid creating fake actual wagers.
Confirm private sync needs sign-in and only confirmed settlement changes result tracking.
Switch back to Today's Board and confirm the ledger is not lost.
expected: Account lines are preserved, bonus credit is valued explicitly, edits invalidate previous results, and no unverified wager is approved.

name: One-tap Today's Board keeps unverified prices separate from bets
covers: live game score clock and receiving usage
automatic free refresh without provider credits
explicit halftime status with absent clock
no invented model thresholds as sportsbook lines
exact public quote repricing and missing period
independent ESPN event and current-season roster
CFB TD model unsupported does not use NFL receptions
full rushing and receiving touchdown label
description: Default mobile screen is simple, does not call paid providers, and never presents a price observation as an approved bet.
steps: Open the app and verify Today's Board is initially selected with Scan today's games visible and Advanced Research accessible.
Click Scan today's games and wait for market coverage or a plainly displayed upstream error.
When the scan returns, confirm the decision identifies HOLD or requires additional verification; a $0 stake is shown.
Inspect a WATCH card and confirm exact book/source and price are labeled observations with EV unavailable; filter to NFL and back to All sports.

For a visible public player prop, wait for the automatic verification summary, expand View verification evidence and missing requirements, and inspect the twelve separate checks. Current public selection and independent event/roster may be confirmed; account offer, bookmaker timestamp, game-day availability, equivalent rules, two reference books, approved model and EV must remain missing unless supported. Confirm HOLD and stake $0.

If a Rushing + Receiving Touchdowns card is shown, confirm the full market label and that a college-football prop cannot inherit the NFL reception model. Use Refresh evidence and verify a newly checked report or a visible source failure. No paid provider request may be made.
Click Copy research when available; ensure no wager was submitted.
Open Live & 2H and wait for the real scoreboard or an explicit source error. Verify returned games have score, phase and clock, and first-half or second-half progress is not labeled halftime.

Inspect the second-half-only filter and source counts; missing 2H offers must not be relabeled full-game offers. Confirm the independent full-game and halftime model scores are visible and both remain research-only.

Inspect Independent halftime outlook. Before halftime, show automatic waiting; after second-half play starts, show the closed forecast window. At confirmed halftime, show independent threshold probabilities or a specific player-data reason even when quotes are empty. Thresholds must be labeled research questions, not offered lines.
expected: The everyday dashboard remains usable on mobile. Zero provider credits are used and no fake live price, model EV, account availability, or placed wager is claimed.

name: Bookmaker tools remain opt-in and expose missing verification
covers: 0.5 percent parlay 3 percent game and 5 percent daily caps
cancel queued request on game change or navigation
description: Existing feed checks, signed-in sportsbook comparisons and parlay diagnostics remain available without automatic paid requests.
steps: Click Advanced Research and select Bookmakers & diagnostics.
Confirm IntegrationDiagnostics, Model & sportsbook references, Caesars evidence and ParlayAudit are visible.
Inspect provider statuses without manually authorizing a paid quote refresh.
Confirm signed-in provider-credit requests retain their opt-in controls and that missing accepted account prices do not create EV claims.
Return to Today's Board.
Open Live & 2H. Use Check connection · 0 credits and inspect the authentication or configuration result without loading any credit-consuming markets.
Verify provider price buttons cannot be used before sign-in and unavailable provider setup is stated clearly. Do not spend credits during this test.

Inspect the slip and boost form: actual combined payout, latest bankroll, exposure, profit-versus-return boost, stake limit and expiry inputs must be present. The Evaluate selected 2H slip button stays disabled with fewer than two selections.
Use Find 2H research draft. If the live data does not support a draft, require an explicit HOLD explanation. No selection can be promoted to a BET from an unvalidated joint probability.

Inspect Prepare 2H: the one-shot maximum 3-credit cost and open-visible-page requirement must be visible. It must be unavailable outside the first half or halftime. Do not trigger sign-in or spend credits in QA.
expected: The expert sportsbook/diagnostic toolset is preserved, credentials are not exposed and ordinary navigation spends no provider credits.
